AN ACT to amend the Physical Planning and Development
Control Act No. 23 of 2016.
[6th October, 2017].
BE IT ENACTED by the Queen’s Most Excellent
Majesty, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate
and the House of Representatives and by the authority of the
same as follows–
1.—(1) This Act may be cited as the Short title.
PHYSICAL PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT
CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017,
and shall be read as one with the Physical Planning and
Development Control Act No. 23 of 2016 hereinafter
referred to as the “principal Act”.
2. Section 2 of the principal Act is amended by deleting Amendment
the definition of “Physical Planning Unit” where it appears of section 2 of
and substituting therefor the following– principal Act.
